# datadog_status_page_email_access_policy (Resource)

Provides a Datadog status page email access policy resource. This can be used to control which email addresses can access a private status page. Deny policies take precedence over allow policies.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Create new datadog_status_page_email_access_policy resource

resource "datadog_status_page" "acme_private_status_page" {
  name               = "Acme Private Status"
  type               = "private"
  domain_prefix      = "acme-private-status"
  visualization_type = "bars_and_uptime_percentage"
}

# Allow every address in the example.com domain.
resource "datadog_status_page_email_access_policy" "allow_domain" {
  page_id = datadog_status_page.acme_private_status_page.id
  pattern = "@example.com"
  effect  = "allow"
}

# Deny a single address. Deny policies take precedence over allow policies.
resource "datadog_status_page_email_access_policy" "deny_address" {
  page_id = datadog_status_page.acme_private_status_page.id
  pattern = "contractor@example.com"
  effect  = "deny"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `effect` (String) The effect applied when an email address matches the policy. Deny policies take precedence over allow policies. Valid values are `allow`, `deny`.
- `page_id` (String) The ID of the private status page this email access policy belongs to.
- `pattern` (String) The email address pattern matched by the policy. Supports an exact address (`user@example.com`), all addresses in a domain (`@example.com`), or all addresses in subdomains (`@*.example.com`).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the email access policy was created.
- `id` (String) The ID of the email access policy.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import datadog_status_page_email_access_policy.example "09a89ab4-d622-4fbd-87e5-81b4124bd064:7c4f9a3e-2b1d-4e6a-9f0c-3d8b5a1e6c2f"
```
